codex-rollout-0.164.0-fork-boundary.json: Synthetic. Shape of a Copied-persistence fork at openai/codex rust-v0.164.0: session_meta with forked_from_id, then the parent's records restamped with the fork time (JsonlWriter.write_rollout_item uses now_utc), including a copied thread_settings_applied event that keeps the parent's thread_id (ThreadSettingsAppliedEvent doc), then one thread_settings_applied event owned by the fork thread appended in the same batch (core/src/session/mod.rs, InitialHistory::Forked). Event envelope: RolloutItemWire event_msg with payload type thread_settings_applied (history/src/rollout_payload.rs, protocol EventMsg snake_case tag). Not a live capture of a forked Codex thread.
